purpose: Machine-readable current-state corrections that must be applied when reconciling the canonical mission snapshot with later verified repository evidence.

legacy_autonomous_engineering_state.rule: Retain for historical reconstruction; do not inherit its stale mission label, branch or commit as current state.

finite_closure_artifacts.rule: Closure of a finite audit or limitation set does not close the continuous mission.
